test_draw_strand_arrows: test draw_strand_arrows to render chevron markers for positive and negative strand transcripts
test_draw_transcript: test draw_transcript to verify num_transcripts is forwarded to draw_strand_arrows
test_plot_transcripts: test plot_transcripts to verify it passes transcript count to draw_transcript for each transcript
test_chevron_vertices: test chevron arrow vertices for correct positive right-pointing and negative left-pointing shapes
test_arrow_filtering: test that small introns and edge arrows are filtered and max arrows are capped
